title: PCA-Bench: Evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models in Perception-Cognition-Action Chain
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It evaluates Multimodal Large Language Models on their ability to perform a Perception-Cognition-Action reasoning chain for decision-making in three complex scenarios: autonomous driving, domestic robotics, and open-world games.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
